translations.web: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;
translations.bsb: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.
translations.kjv: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
translations.asv: And he that was sown upon the rocky places, this is he that heareth the word, and straightway with joy receiveth it;
